item.title: [IGNITE-12828] Intermittent [Failed to notify direct custom event listener] exception on node shutdown
item.description:

  • Creates cache "cache1"
  • Deploys a grid service that starts a continuous query against "cache1" in method init()

item.summary: Intermittent [Failed to notify direct custom event listener] exception on node shutdown

status.description: A resolution has been taken, and it is awaiting verification by reporter. From here issues are either reopened, or are closed.

comments.comment:
The problem is due to lack of synchronization between the node shutdown and continuous query handler initialization:

  • The problem occurred due to NPE here, which is called from continuous query handler initialization
  • cntrs is set to null on the node shutdown
  • There is no reliable synchronization on the node shutdown. There are GridKernalContext#isStopping checks spread all over the code to detect whether the node is shutting down.
  • Here is the last node shutdown check on continuous query handler initialization. But there are time-consuming things happening  between that check and the NPE from this problem like deploying classes. The NPE occurs if the node shutdown started in parallel.

The mentioned in the ticket behavior can be explained as follows.
The client node receives a message for CQ registration and starts its processing.
The client node leaves the cluster before the registration finished.  
That causes CQ handler registration failure wile P2P class loading. That leads to NPE during work with uninitialized handler properties because mention above failure is not handled properly.

Branch: [pull/7620/head] Base: [master] : No blockers found!

TeamCity --> Run :: All Results
There is another case when the mentioned NPE can occur. It is described by https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/IGNITE-12865.

Merged to master.
